## Six Flags to Announce 2026 Third Quarter Results on November 5; Earnings Call Starts at 8 AM EST


October 07, 2026


Download (opens in new window)


CHARLOTTE, N.C.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Six Flags Entertainment Corporation (NYSE: FUN), the largest regional amusement park operator in North America, said today it will issue 2026 third-quarter results in the pre-market hours of Thursday, November 5, 2026.


Starting at 8 a.m. EST that day, Six Flags management will host a conference call for the investment community to provide additional details regarding third-quarter results and discuss the Company’s business outlook. Management participants on the call will include Six Flags CEO John Reilly and CFO Ash Walia.


Investors and all other interested parties can access a live, listen-only audio webcast of the call on the Six Flags investor website[https://investors.sixflags.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.sixflags.com&esheet=54617997&newsitemid=20261007925585&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.sixflags.com&index=1&md5=2e2bd8e04de5678dfdae532f84f44be5) under the tabs Investor Information / Events & Presentations. Those unable to listen to the live webcast can visit our investor website where we will post a playback shortly after the live call’s conclusion.


**ABOUT SIX FLAGS ENTERTAINMENT CORPORATION** Six Flags Entertainment Corporation (NYSE: FUN) is North America’s largest regional amusement-resort enterprise. The Company operates a premier portfolio of 20 amusement parks, 14 water parks, and nine resort properties across 13 U.S. states, Canada, and Mexico, as well as an amusement park in Saudi Arabia. Focused on its purpose of creating FUN, thrills, and a lifetime of memories, Six Flags provides immersive entertainment to millions of guests every year with world-class coasters, themed rides, and thrilling water parks powered by beloved intellectual property such as Looney Tunes®, DC Comics®, and PEANUTS®.
